authority: Latest direct user clarification; supersedes earlier preference to subtract recurrent injury from main OVR.
mainOvr: Healthy playing ability and demonstrated contribution at a supported workload. No injury-availability deduction in primary OVR, whether one or several injury seasons.
availability: Display separately, with documented multi-season recurrence, source coverage and uncertainty. Existing 0/.05/.10 adjusted-contribution probe values are sensitivity diagnostics only, not selected main OVR.
bench: Do not extrapolate short-load per36 to starter efficiency. Supported load and opponent/role context remain relevant; minutes saturate. Sixth-man quality can be high. Do not enforce a bench-name blacklist.
separateSystems: Simulation may use detailed measured descriptors and complex mechanisms. Display OVR is a transparent interpretable summary of player strength, not required to be a simulator input or derived only from simulated replacement wins.
majorGoal: Individual and team simulation errors sufficiently small, with explicit checks and limitations.
intermediateGoal: Objective evidence-based interpretable player ranking; target names and positional counts are sanity checks, not training labels.
currentClosure: Finish and disclose v41 results, preserve failed gates, and stop opening further mechanism versions merely to fix the ranking. Latest complete all-player ranking remains unaccepted v24. A new display OVR requires its own fixed definition and validation.
videoInput: Read user-pasted summary, not full video captions. Multi-metric triangulation is useful evidence; no claim its stated rankings are independently verified truth. Check dependence, context, rate versus cumulative value and small-sample uncertainty before using metrics.
